title: Airborne Lindon
specs: Largest indoor playground in Utah County for ages 10 and under (SpaceStation)
Utah's longest indoor zipline at 90 feet
Over 40 trampolines in the main Air Arena
Ages 5 and up for general jumping; ages 0-4 have separate pricing and access
Children ages 6 and under should never be left unattended
Do not participate if you have health limitations, injuries, or are under the influence of drugs or alcohol, or are pregnant
Minimum height 48" for Air Ninja, Wipeout, and The Cube attractions
Grip socks required for participation; can be purchased for $3 or bring your own
Party packages available with dedicated party areas
includes: Airborne Flight Crew monitor supervision during camps and jumping
Snapology teacher instruction for educational activities during camps
Swag bag including Airborne Summer Camp T-shirt and grip socks for camps
gap: Exact cancellation policy for general admission not stated
blurb: Airborne Lindon offers a large indoor trampoline park with various attractions including trampolines, a zipline, trapeze, obstacle courses, and extreme slides. They also provide summer camps combining jumping activities with S.T.E.A.M. education using LEGO® building blocks. Party packages and group events are available with dedicated party areas.
extraNote: Non-refundable $100 deposit required to book a party, applied to final bill · Outside food allowed only for guests with booked party packages; otherwise $50 fee · Parties causing excessive mess may incur a $50 cleaning fee · Parties staying longer than 15 minutes after end may be charged $50 fee · Grip socks required for participation for insurance and safety
